one_line: Gond ruler of Garha restored under Mughal suzerainty after Asaf Khan’s conquest.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy hill-warrior build with broad shoulders and wiry arms
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown central Indian complexion, straight nose, close-trimmed moustache with a small pointed beard, faint worry line between brows; default expression calm and observant, with serious eyes that can flash with determination
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, sides neat, no shave; a narrow dark-red cloth turban (pagri) wrapped compactly with a subtle central pleat and a small plain copper disc at the front, no feathers
appearance.costume: a knee-length white cotton angarkha (overlapping front robe) with side ties and a slightly flared skirt, worn over a pale-cream cotton tunic; a deep-forest-green quilted cotton coat (like a light padded kurta) sleeveless and open at the front, edged with simple brown piping; lower body in dark-ochre cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; around his waist a broad maroon woven cloth belt (kamarband) wrapped twice with one end tucked neatly; on his feet sturdy dark-brown leather sandals with simple straps; he wears a single medium-width copper bangle on his right wrist, a plain copper ring on his left hand, and small round copper ear studs; draped over one shoulder is a muted indigo cotton shawl with a thin off-white border, practical for hill weather and used like a cloak when riding between forts
appearance.signature: a medium-length straight-backed steel sword with a slightly leaf-shaped blade; hilt in the early Indo-Turkic style but plain, with a gently curving iron crossguard and a simple disc pommel wrapped in dark-brown leather, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard worn at his left hip and often rested lightly in his right hand

ref_desc: Chandra Shah is a mid-30s lean hill-warrior with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a low knot under a narrow dark-red turban, wearing a white angarkha, forest-green sleeveless quilted coat, dark-ochre trousers, maroon waist-belt, indigo shawl, and carrying a plain-hilt steel sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chandra Shah, a mid-30s lean but sturdy central Indian hill ruler, with an oval medium-brown face, high cheekbones, a straight nose, a close-trimmed moustache and small pointed beard, and calm, observant eyes. His thick black hair is pulled into a low knot at the back, wrapped by a narrow dark-red cloth turban with a subtle central pleat and a small plain copper disc at the front. He wears a knee-length white cotton angarkha with overlapping front panels, over a pale-cream tunic, and a deep-forest-green sleeveless quilted cotton coat open at the front with simple brown edging. His trousers are dark-ochre, fitted and gathered at the ankles, and a broad maroon cloth waist-belt is wrapped twice around his waist with one end tucked in cleanly. On his feet are sturdy dark-brown leather sandals. He has a single copper bangle on his right wrist, a plain copper ring on his left hand, and small round copper ear studs. An indigo cotton shawl with a thin off-white border is draped over one shoulder like a practical cloak. His signature weapon is a medium-length straight steel sword with a slightly leaf-shaped blade, a plain iron crossguard, a disc pommel wrapped in dark-brown leather, and a simple brown leather scabbard at his left hip, which he lightly grips with his right hand. Use a palette dominated by forest green, maroon, white, dark ochre, and indigo, and keep the overall look grounded, dignified, and historically plausible for late 16th-century Gond territory under Mughal suzerainty.
